title: Northgate Delivery & Installation Base Delivery Fees and Plus Base-Fee Discounts
content:
The base delivery fee is the fee for the service level itself, charged at booking. Each Northgate Delivery & Installation service level also sets the percentage discount on that base fee that applies when the purchase carried a Plus-tier membership.

| Service level | Base delivery fee | Plus base-fee discount |
|---|---|---|
| Northgate Curbside Delivery | $0.00 | 0 percent |
| Northgate Threshold Delivery | $39.00 | 100 percent |
| Northgate Room of Choice Delivery | $89.00 | 50 percent |
| Northgate White Glove Delivery | $149.00 | 25 percent |
| Northgate Appliance Delivery & Installation | $0.00 | 0 percent |
| Northgate TV Delivery & Wall-Mount Installation | $0.00 | 0 percent |

Delivery fees are kept per appointment in USD, and the fees on an appointment are counted net of the credits posted against them.

## The base fee once the Plus discount is taken

The figures below follow from the schedule: the discount is the stated percentage of the level's base fee.

| Service level | Base fee | Discount taken | Base fee after the Plus discount |
|---|---|---|---|
| Northgate Threshold Delivery | $39.00 | 100 percent of $39.00 | $0.00 |
| Northgate Room of Choice Delivery | $89.00 | 50 percent of $89.00 | $44.50 |
| Northgate White Glove Delivery | $149.00 | 25 percent of $149.00 | $111.75 |

Northgate Curbside Delivery, Northgate Appliance Delivery & Installation and Northgate TV Delivery & Wall-Mount Installation carry a base fee of $0.00 and a discount of 0 percent, so there is nothing for a Plus discount to reduce at those levels.

## Points of reference

- **Which level has the largest base fee?** Northgate White Glove Delivery, at $149.00.
- **At which level does the Plus discount remove the whole base fee?** Northgate Threshold Delivery, where the discount is 100 percent.
- **Do the installation levels carry a base fee?** No. Both Northgate Appliance Delivery & Installation and Northgate TV Delivery & Wall-Mount Installation carry a base delivery fee of $0.00.
